title: Cohomology on a colimit of sites
statement:
In the situation of [lem-weil-pbc-colimit-of-sites] (a cofiltered $\mathcal I$, sites $\mathcal C_i$ with finite coverings, morphisms of sites $f_a$ given by $u_a$, the colimit site $\mathcal C$ with $f_i:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C_i$ given by $u_i$), let $\mathcal F_i$ be an abelian sheaf on $\mathcal C_i$ for every $i$, and for $a:j\to i$ let $\varphi_a:f_a^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to\mathcal F_j$ be a map of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C_j$, with $\varphi_c=\varphi_b\circ f_b^{-1}\varphi_a$ whenever $c=a\circ b$. The maps $f_j^{-1}\varphi_a:f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i=f_j^{-1}f_a^{-1}\mathcal F_i\to f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j$ make $(f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i)$ a filtered system of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C$; set $\mathcal F=\varinjlim f_i^{-1}\mathcal F_i$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Then for every $i$, every $X_i\in\operatorname{Ob}(\mathcal C_i)$ and every $p\ge0$ the canonical map
$$\varinjlim_{a:j\to i}H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)\longrightarrow H^p(u_i(X_i),\mathcal F)$$
is an isomorphism ($H^p$ over an object, [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]); the map sends the class of $\xi\in H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)$ to the image of $\xi$ under the pullback along $f_j$ ($H^p(u_a(X_i),\mathcal F_j)\to H^p(u_j(u_a(X_i)),f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j)$, induced by the adjunction unit $\mathcal F_j\to f_{j*}f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j$ on an injective resolution) followed by the coprojection $f_j^{-1}\mathcal F_j\to\mathcal F$, with $u_j(u_a(X_i))=u_i(X_i)$.
